baseline: Round 80 Phase 1 plus documented post-baseline deltas
status: findings only; remediation and publication are not authorized

issues.title: Touchbaes is vertically clipped at the 1024px boundary
issues.recommendation: Choose a complete-content river height or proportional boundary scale, then verify interaction and shadows.
issues.verification: All 22 pairwise states at 1024px show zero ancestor clipping and the game remains operable.

issues.title: Random Pics is vertically clipped across expanded widths
issues.recommendation: Make the band intrinsically contain its caption, 12px gap, and reel while preserving the untitled interlude.
issues.verification: Zero clip observations from 1024 through 2940px in all pairwise states.

issues.title: Published Cargo adds invalid ARIA attributes to all project rivers
issues.recommendation: Remove the runtime mutation from native rivers while retaining the separate scrubber semantics.
issues.verification: Axe has zero aria-allowed-attr failures and native pan-x pan-y remains intact.

issues.title: The document language is missing on all routes
issues.recommendation: Set the correct root language without altering page layout.
issues.verification: Local, Cargo, and public route captures report the intended language and no html-has-lang violation.

issues.title: Compact text links trigger target-size warnings
issues.recommendation: Test the WCAG spacing exception and physical usability before changing the approved tight leading.
issues.decision_gate: Ocean approves any visible spacing change.
issues.verification: Physical touch testing and WCAG target-spacing evidence across compact widths.

issues.title: Girly, Contrast, and Quirky fail normal-text contrast
issues.recommendation: Approve revised palette values or separate accessible semantic text/control tokens.
issues.decision_gate: Ocean approves every visible color change.
issues.verification: All normal text and essential controls meet 4.5:1 in every selectable theme.

issues.title: Portfolio media lacks stable alternatives and labelled project structure
issues.recommendation: Classify decorative versus meaningful media, approve concise alternatives, and add visual-neutral project labels.
issues.decision_gate: Ocean approves alternative text and semantic labels.
issues.verification: Screen-reader tree exposes stable names and project navigation without duplicate noise.

issues.title: Continuous autoplay motion has no pause or reduced-motion pathway
issues.recommendation: Approve a global pause or reduced-motion experience while retaining intentional default motion.
issues.decision_gate: Ocean approves the control and fallback treatment.
issues.verification: Reduced-motion and pause paths stop continuous motion; normal mode preserves four Withered eye-roll hooks.

issues.title: Published Cargo over-fetches media during compact startup
issues.recommendation: Diff deployed body/runtime behavior before changing the canonical loading policy.
issues.decision_gate: None after the activating runtime is proven.
issues.verification: Published compact startup approaches the deterministic deferred envelope without blank frames.

issues.title: Synthetic scroll cadence and compact layout shift miss targets
issues.recommendation: Profile media settlement and compositing on physical iPhone and desktop before optimizing.
issues.decision_gate: Choose fixes only after traces identify cost centers.
issues.verification: Representative hardware reaches the audit budgets without visual regression.

issues.title: Expanded content-visibility may prune projects from assistive navigation
issues.recommendation: Test full traversal with VoiceOver and NVDA before changing containment.
issues.verification: All projects are reachable in supported screen readers without unacceptable performance loss.

issues.title: Figma mobile Write contains a duplicate Clout passage
issues.recommendation: Remove only the accidental second instance; keep the intended Clout passage.
issues.decision_gate: None; Cargo's five-piece structure is authoritative.
issues.verification: Figma mobile and desktop each contain five passages and one Clout instance.

issues.title: Desktop panel width is bound to uncapped col/2
issues.recommendation: Bind the component to panel/width so it caps at 250px.
issues.verification: Panel resolves to 250px at the wide endpoint and existing smaller endpoints remain unchanged.

issues.title: Desktop panel height documentation conflicts with live geometry
issues.recommendation: Choose the live 248px composition or the documented 232px target, then update both systems.
issues.verification: Figma description, component, and Cargo match at 1024, 1440, and capped widths.

issues.title: Compact panel typography does not encode Cargo's Medium contract
issues.recommendation: Bind all labels and slider glyphs to the approved local face/Medium semantics and retain only optical inner-label offsets.
issues.decision_gate: Confirm Medium remains the panel contract.
issues.verification: All four faces and slider glyphs match Cargo metrics and centers.

issues.title: Write desktop relies on fixed frames with unclipped overflow
issues.recommendation: Separate the viewport reference from a Hug-height content container.
issues.decision_gate: None if visible composition is preserved.
issues.verification: Content owns its complete height and survives type/copy changes without clipping.

issues.title: Write mobile simulates col/4 by clipping col/6 instances
issues.recommendation: Give the passage instance its real responsive col/4 width instead of a clipped wrapper.
issues.decision_gate: None if visible composition is preserved.
issues.verification: No wrapper crop is required across faces and scales.

issues.title: Expanded Write spacing trails the current Figma component
issues.recommendation: Align the 16px title/body gap and first-row height after visual approval.
issues.decision_gate: Ocean approves the resulting vertical shift.
issues.verification: Figma and Cargo geometry match at the reference widths.

issues.title: Figma variable scopes and descriptions are incomplete
issues.recommendation: Add appropriate scopes/descriptions and separate typography routing from Space when practical.
issues.verification: Variable picker exposes intended properties and every semantic token is documented.

issues.title: Home is indexable under duplicate hosts and paths
issues.recommendation: Approve one canonical authority, redirect aliases, and remove duplicate sitemap entries.
issues.verification: One canonical Home URL remains indexable and aliases normalize predictably.

issues.title: Indexed legacy project routes end at an empty 404
issues.recommendation: Approve stable project fragments and a precise legacy redirect table.
issues.decision_gate: Ocean approves project destinations and the historic slug map.
issues.verification: Known old routes 301 to the closest surviving project destination.

issues.title: Home, Write, and Who lack coherent route-to-content heading hierarchy
issues.recommendation: Approve one route-level heading and subordinate project/profile/piece headings with no visual change by default.
issues.decision_gate: Ocean decides Random Pics labelling and any visible route heading.
issues.verification: Screen-reader heading navigation reflects the information architecture.

issues.title: Expanded primary navigation is exposed as complementary content
issues.recommendation: Expose the link group as a labelled primary navigation landmark without geometry change.
issues.verification: Expanded accessibility tree contains the intended navigation landmark at all widths.

issues.title: Write and Who reuse Home metadata
issues.recommendation: Approve concise route-specific descriptions and intentional social imagery.
issues.decision_gate: Ocean approves the copy and any new assets.
issues.verification: Search/social probes show route-accurate titles, descriptions, and images.

issues.title: The 404 page has no recovery path
issues.recommendation: Create a minimal raw MM.S 404 with primary links while retaining HTTP 404.
issues.verification: Unknown routes retain 404 status and expose useful recovery links.

issues.title: The public favicon is Cargo's default
issues.recommendation: Approve and deploy a small MM.S favicon set.
issues.verification: Browser/tab/bookmark checks use the MM.S asset on light and dark chrome.

issues.title: Legacy Home autoplay fights the deferred-media controller
issues.recommendation: Make the observer lifecycle the sole playback owner and scope iOS retries to loaded near media.
issues.verification: Far-offscreen videos receive no play attempts and visible media still autoplay on iOS.

issues.title: Deployment preflight accepts missing media and stale runtime markers
issues.recommendation: Add a reviewed manifest for runtime/head versions, ordered media IDs, band counts, embeds, and critical geometry.
issues.decision_gate: Manifest updates require explicit baseline approval.
issues.verification: Negative fixtures for missing WTW, V7, Touchbaes, or stale markers fail closed locally and after Cargo reload.

issues.title: Root-aware initialization has no teardown
issues.recommendation: Centralize listeners, intervals, observers, callbacks, and embed state under an explicit teardown owner.
issues.verification: Root replacement leaves one owner and panel/dialog state remains coherent.

issues.title: V7 and Touchbaes messaging is wildcarded or incompletely validated
issues.recommendation: Use a versioned envelope, exact target origins, and source plus origin validation at both ends.
issues.verification: Wrong-origin/window/kind/version messages have no effect; valid messages retain behavior.

issues.title: Compact Montran page turning is pointer-only
issues.recommendation: Expose a focusable semantic turn path and Left/Right keys while keeping the artwork control-free.
issues.verification: Keyboard and VoiceOver can turn one page without breaking touch taps or native scrolling.

issues.title: The harness inventories controls but does not exercise primary interactions
issues.recommendation: Add a separate deterministic interaction suite for panel, scrubber, rivers, lifecycle, state, messages, and Montran.
issues.verification: Each listed flow has positive and negative automated coverage.

issues.title: Touchbaes injects child-supplied executable markup into the parent
issues.recommendation: Send only bounded declarative state and build the parent rig from trusted local DOM/assets.
issues.verification: No message-derived string reaches innerHTML and the tweezer interaction remains exact.

issues.title: Active V7 and Montran bundles cannot be recreated from tracked source
issues.recommendation: Track authoritative sources and deterministic builders that reproduce the active contracts from a clean checkout.
issues.verification: Clean-checkout builds match approved hashes or explicit integration contracts.

issues.title: Executable iframes have no explicit sandbox, permissions, or referrer policy
issues.recommendation: Test and document the minimum per-embed policy without breaking origin identity or features.
issues.verification: Policies are explicit and all approved interactions still pass.

issues.title: Montran accepts arbitrary CORS-readable PDF URLs
issues.recommendation: Allowlist the approved report or narrow Freight HTTPS paths before any fetch.
issues.verification: Approved URL range-loads; unapproved protocols/origins/paths are rejected before network activity.

issues.title: Public responses lack browser security policy headers
issues.recommendation: Determine Cargo capabilities, begin CSP report-only, then add exact referrer, permission, MIME, frame, and HTTPS policies.
issues.decision_gate: Cargo or edge capability and clean report-only evidence.
issues.verification: Enforced headers pass the full compact/expanded interaction matrix.

issues.title: Framer helper contains a high-severity dependency advisory
issues.recommendation: Pin reviewed versions, move outside the advisory range, rerun design reads, and require a clean audit.
issues.verification: Lockfile is deterministic and npm audit reports no known vulnerability.

issues.title: StPageFlip's MIT notice is missing from tracked distribution records
issues.recommendation: Add a consolidated third-party notice file and preserve notices through builds.
issues.verification: All vendored runtime dependencies and required notices are documented.

issues.title: The site's low-collection privacy behavior is undocumented
issues.recommendation: Document stored preferences and contacted vendors without adding analytics.
issues.verification: Documentation matches an independent request/storage audit.

issues.title: Compact Home ends without a visible contact path
issues.recommendation: Approve a compact-only raw contact echo after WTW while preserving the 64px ending space.
issues.decision_gate: Ocean chooses links, a short sentence, or an intentionally contact-free ending.
issues.verification: A compact visitor can contact MM.S at journey end without a generic CTA treatment.

issues.title: Projects have no stable nonserial destination
issues.recommendation: Add stable invisible fragments first; consider a raw-text index only if desired.
issues.decision_gate: Ocean decides whether serial discovery is exclusive.
issues.verification: Named projects can be linked without replacing rivers or changing composition.

issues.title: Navigation does not show visual current location
issues.recommendation: Approve a minimal current-link state using existing type or underline logic.
issues.verification: Direct-entry users identify the route without tabs, pills, breadcrumbs, or new bars.

issues.title: The compact plus is explained only on Home
issues.recommendation: Preserve the plus; add a restrained direct-entry cue only if usability testing confirms confusion.
issues.decision_gate: Ocean decides surprise versus explicit cue.
issues.verification: Direct-entry compact testing confirms panel discoverability without permanent explanatory chrome.

protected_contracts: WTW wtw-02 remains 504 by 504 and unclipped.
Withered Green retains exactly four Cargo-native eye-roll paragraph hooks and no animated heading.
Horizontal rivers remain native with no wheel interception, forced stepping, snapping, or animated correction.
